summary.state: 就业降温改写加息预期：9 月非农只增 2.9 万，10 月加息概率从约 64% 降至约 18%；美股普涨、纳指 +1.2%、VIX -6.6%，但 10 年期收盘仍在 5.28%——环境压力转为缓和，期限溢价仍在。
summary.state_en: Cooling jobs rewrite hike expectations: payrolls +29k cut October hike odds from ~64% to ~18%; stocks rallied (Nasdaq +1.2%, VIX -6.6%) yet the 10-year still closed at 5.28% — pressure eases, term premium persists.

changed.what: 非农 +2.9 万（预期 8.5 万），失业率 4.2%；10 月加息概率约 18%。
changed.why: 过去一周"油价 → 加息"的主线被就业数据打断，利率敏感资产获得喘息。
changed.why_en: The week's oil → hikes narrative was interrupted by jobs data, giving rate-sensitive assets room.

changed.var: 长端利率没有跟着回落
changed.what: 10 年期收盘 5.28%（+4bp），仍在 2007 年以来高位附近。
changed.what_en: The 10-year closed at 5.28% (+4bp), still near its highest since 2007.
changed.why: 短期加息预期下降，但长端仍要求更高的期限溢价——"降息交易"还没开始。
changed.why_en: Near-term hike odds fell but the long end still demands term premium — the 'cut trade' has not begun.

changed.what: 光互连与芯片设备反弹，存储股因东芝扩产暴跌约 10%。
changed.what_en: Optical and chip-equipment names rallied while storage fell ~10% on Toshiba's expansion.
changed.why: AI 需求仍在，但市场开始区分"有供给约束的环节"和"会被扩产稀释的环节"。
changed.why_en: AI demand persists, but markets now separate supply-constrained links from those exposed to new capacity.

not_changed.zh: 股市反弹不等于利率压力解除：10 年期收盘反而上升 4bp，30 年期仍在二十多年高位附近。
not_changed.en: The rally does not mean rate pressure is gone: the 10-year closed 4bp higher and the 30-year remains near multi-decade highs.

not_changed.zh: 存储股暴跌不等于 AI 需求转弱：东芝扩产恰恰是因为 AI 存储需求旺盛，冲击的是竞争格局。
not_changed.en: The storage slump does not signal weaker AI demand: Toshiba is expanding precisely because demand is strong — the hit is to competition.

geo.event: 9 月非农仅增 2.9 万，失业率升至 4.2%；10 月加息概率骤降
geo.event_en: September payrolls +29k, unemployment 4.2%; October hike odds collapse
geo.assets: 美债、美元、成长股、利率敏感周期股
geo.assets_en: Treasuries, dollar, growth stocks, rate-sensitive cyclicals
geo.logic: 劳动力市场明显降温，削弱了"油价 → 通胀 → 继续加息"的逻辑；加息概率下降推动股市反弹，但长端收益率收盘仍上升，说明期限溢价还在。
geo.logic_en: A cooling labour market undercuts the oil → inflation → more hikes chain; lower hike odds lifted stocks, yet long yields still closed higher — the term premium remains.
geo.facts: 非农 +2.9 万（预期 8.5 万，8 月修正为 13.3 万），失业率 4.2%（前值 4.1%）；CME FedWatch 显示 10/28 会议加息概率约 18%（一周前约 64%）。报道称收益率在数据公布后回落，但本看台收盘数据显示 10 年期为 5.28%（+4bp）。
geo.facts_en: Payrolls +29k (consensus 85k; August revised to 133k), unemployment 4.2% (from 4.1%); CME FedWatch puts October hike odds at ~18% (from ~64% a week earlier). Reports said yields fell after the release, but this dashboard's close shows the 10-year at 5.28% (+4bp).

review.note: 本期到期 6 条：4 条被证伪、2 条证据一致。共同偏差：高估了利率压力对股市和黄金的持续压制，低估了就业数据转弱带来的预期反转。
review.note_en: Six calls matured: four falsified, two consistent. Shared bias: overestimating how persistently rate pressure would weigh on equities and gold, and underestimating a jobs-driven reversal in expectations.

items.claim: （9/25）10 年期上破 5.2% 后，纳指会否在同一周回落？
items.claim_en: (9/25) If the 10-year breaks 5.2%, does the Nasdaq fall that week?
items.outcome_en: The 10-year stayed above 5.2% all week (5.24–5.29%), yet the Nasdaq rose 0.45% from 9/25 to 10/2. Falsifier met.
items.lesson: "收益率处于高位"本身不足以压制科技股；真正起作用的是增长 / 就业预期的方向。触发器要搭配增长指标一起看。
items.lesson_en: A high yield level alone did not suppress tech; the direction of growth and jobs expectations mattered more. Pair rate triggers with a growth gauge.

items.claim_en: (9/28) With the 10-year above 5.2%, does gold close below 4,154.7 on 10/2?
items.outcome: 10/2 黄金期货收于 4,172.1，10 年期为 5.28%。反证条件成立。
items.outcome_en: Gold futures closed 4,172.1 on 10/2 with the 10-year at 5.28%. Falsifier met.
items.lesson: 黄金对加息概率比对 10 年期水平更敏感：加息概率从约 70% 降到约 18%，抵消了长端高位的压力。
items.lesson_en: Gold tracked hike odds more than the 10-year level: odds falling from ~70% to ~18% offset the high long end.

items.claim: （9/28）A股光模块会否在国庆前继续下跌（9/29–9/30 累计为负）？
items.claim_en: (9/28) Do A-share optical names keep falling before the holiday?
items.outcome: 两日累计等权约 +0.9%：天孚通信 +6.5%、光迅科技 +0.7%，中际旭创 -0.8%、新易盛 -2.7%。被美国提案点名的两家仍下跌，但整体为正。
items.outcome_en: Two-day EW ~+0.9%: TFC +6.5%, Accelink +0.7%, Innolight -0.8%, Eoptolink -2.7%. The two named in the US bill still fell, but the group was positive.
items.lesson: 应按"是否被政策直接点名"拆分篮子：直接受影响的两家判断方向正确，整体篮子被另两家抵消。
items.lesson_en: Split the basket by direct policy exposure: the call was right for the two named firms and diluted by the other two.

items.claim: （9/29）美股市场宽度会否在周五前修复到 50% 以上？
items.claim_en: (9/29) Does US breadth recover above 50% before Friday?
items.outcome_en: 9/30 was just 23.6%, but 10/1 reached 58.9% and 10/2 58.6%. The falsifier (any day above 50%) was met.
items.lesson: 宽度在极端低位（23.6%）之后往往快速修复；极端读数更像反转信号，而不是延续信号。
items.lesson_en: Breadth snapped back after an extreme low (23.6%); extremes behaved more like reversal signals than continuation.

items.claim: （9/29）油价回落能否持续到周五（WTI 10/2 不高于 92.98）？
items.claim_en: (9/29) Does oil's retreat hold into Friday (WTI ≤ 92.98 on 10/2)?
items.outcome: WTI 10/2 收于 91.26，未超过 92.98；但 10/1 一度收在 92.92，非常接近阈值。
items.outcome_en: WTI closed 91.26 on 10/2, below 92.98 — though it closed 92.92 on 10/1, very close to the threshold.
items.lesson: 方向正确但余量很小；油价仍高度依赖美伊消息。
items.lesson_en: Right direction, thin margin; oil remains headline-driven.

items.claim: （9/28）芯片抛售是一次性冲击吗（美股 CPO 10/5 前收复 9/25 水平）？
items.claim_en: (9/28) Is the chip selloff a one-off (US CPO back to 9/25 by 10/5)?
items.outcome: 10/2 美股 CPO 11 只相对 9/25 等权 +7.5%，已在时限前收复并超过。
items.outcome_en: By 10/2 the 11 US CPO names were +7.5% EW versus 9/25 — recovered ahead of the horizon.
items.lesson: AI 安全事件属于情绪冲击，没有改变需求预期。
items.lesson_en: The AI-safety scare was a sentiment shock that did not change demand expectations.

items.claim: （9/25）9 月非农偏强会否推高 10 月加息概率？
items.claim_en: (9/25) Would a strong September payrolls print lift October hike odds?
items.outcome: 前提没有出现：非农明显偏弱（+2.9 万），加息概率降至约 18%。条件式判断无法检验。
items.outcome_en: The premise did not occur: payrolls were weak (+29k) and hike odds fell to ~18%. The conditional call cannot be tested.
items.lesson: 条件式判断要同时写出另一分支的预期，才能每次都被检验。
items.lesson_en: Conditional calls should state the other branch too, so they are always testable.
